privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how data is processed when you use Public Transport Walking.
privacy.controllerText: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
privacy.hostingText: This website and its backend are hosted on Microsoft Azure. The hosting provider may process technical access data when requests are made, including IP address, time, requested resource and browser information. This data may be recorded in server logs.
privacy.hostingBasis: Processing is based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, in the legitimate interest of operating the website securely and reliably.
privacy.routesText: Your line, stop and direction selections are made in your browser using the bundled transit data. When you request a walking calculation, your browser sends the coordinates of the selected start and destination stops to the backend. The app does not request your device's location.
privacy.routesGoogle: The backend sends the start and destination coordinates to Google Routes, a service of Google LLC, to calculate distance and walking time. The selected stops may reveal an intended journey. Technical access data may also be processed when the request is made.
privacy.routesBasis: Processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR to provide the function you requested.
privacy.fontsText: The website loads fonts from Google Fonts, a service of Google LLC, via Google's servers. Your browser connects to Google and sends information including your IP address and technical request data.
privacy.fontsBasis: The fonts are used on the basis of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, in the legitimate interest of presenting the website consistently.
privacy.mapsText: You can use the link in the result to open the destination stop in Google Maps. Only when you click the link does your browser open Google Maps and send the destination coordinates; Google may also process other data such as your IP address. Google's privacy policy also applies to Google Routes, Google Fonts and Google Maps.
privacy.storageText: Your chosen appearance (light, dark or system theme) is saved in your browser's local storage so it is remembered on a later visit. You can remove it by clearing the website's data in your browser.
privacy.trackingText: The app does not require an account or itself integrate tracking or analytics tools. It does not itself set tracking cookies.
privacy.rightsText: Subject to the GDPR's conditions, you have rights including access (Article 15), rectification (Article 16), erasure (Article 17), restriction of processing (Article 18), data portability (Article 20), and objection to processing based on Article 6(1)(f) (Article 21).
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise your rights, contact the email address above.
privacy.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority if you believe processing infringes the GDPR.
privacy.changesText: This policy may be updated when the website or legal requirements change.
